description: This PHP source file defines the Importer class used for handling data import processes in SuiteCRM, including data sanitization, validation, saving, and error handling.

classes.name: Importer
classes.description: Class responsible for importing data into SuiteCRM, including row processing, validation, saving, error handling, and mapping.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Importer with source data and target bean, sets up environment and configurations.

methods.name: import
methods.description: Iterates over source data rows and processes each for import.

methods.name: importRow
methods.description: Processes a single data row, including field mapping, validation, and saving.

methods.name: sanitizeFieldValueByType
methods.description: Sanitizes and validates a field value based on its type.

methods.name: cloneExistingBean
methods.description: Clones an existing bean record for update purposes.

methods.name: removeDeletedBean
methods.description: Deletes a bean record from the database.

methods.name: saveImportBean
methods.description: Saves a bean record to the database, handling pre- and post-save logic.

methods.name: saveMappingFile
methods.description: Saves the import field mapping configuration.

methods.name: populateDefaultMapValue
methods.description: Generates default values for fields, considering formats and user preferences.

methods.name: getImportColumns
methods.description: Retrieves importable columns based on request parameters and bean definitions.

methods.name: getFieldSanitizer
methods.description: Creates and configures a field sanitizer object based on import source locale settings.

methods.name: setFieldKeyTranslator
methods.description: Sets a mapping from internal field keys to external source keys for import.

methods.name: _undoCreatedBeans
methods.description: Undoes creation of beans if import fails.

methods.name: _convertId
methods.description: Sanitizes and converts IDs to a safe format.

methods.name: retrieveAdvancedMapping
methods.description: Retrieves advanced mapping and duplicate settings from request.

methods.name: getImportableModules
methods.description: Returns a list of modules that are importable.

methods.name: handleImportErrors
methods.description: Custom error handler for import process errors.

methods.name: checkRelatedIDsAfterSave
methods.description: Ensures related and parent IDs are correctly associated after saving a bean.
